newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber edges up, Thai news seen bearish.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber edges up, Thai news seen bearish.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices edged up in late morning trading on Friday, helped by extended gains in Tokyo, traders said.
They said September shipment SIR20 was done at 43.50 cents/lb fob Palembang, but overall activity in other key centers was quiet despite some enquiries.
"One Singapore dealer was seeking to buy SIR20 at 43.00 cents, but my offer was $43.50," one Medan trader said.
Traders said the Thai government's decision to default on 23,100 tonnes of rubber it had bought from Thai farmers would dampened sentiment.
"The rubber has to be sold elsewhere, and this means there will be more rubber available in the market," one trader said. "Thai rubber prices are already at a discount to ours."
"Fortunately for us, prices in Tokyo were a little higher yesterday," he said. "Prices were continuing rise in Tokyo this morning, and this should help to counter the Thai news."

Traders said September SIR20 prices were quoted 0.25-0.50 cents higher at 43.50-44.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 43.50 fob Palembang and Padang, 43.75 cents fob Surabaya and 43.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
